FlowerPainter.Parking.Name: Parking lot
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.StallAngle: How the spaces sit against the driving lane. Angled spaces are easier to drive into but fit fewer cars.
FlowerPainter.Parking.StallAngle.90.Tip: Spaces at right angles to the lane. Fits the most cars.
FlowerPainter.Parking.StallAngle.60.Tip: Slanted spaces, a little easier to drive into.
FlowerPainter.Parking.StallAngle.45.Tip: Strongly slanted spaces. Easiest to drive into, fits the fewest cars.
Where cars and people get in and out. We put entrances on the nearest street for you; pick a type, click the outline next to a street to add one, right-click one to remove it.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Marker.Entrance.Ti: Cars come in and go out here. Joins the street without changing it.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Marker.Entry.Tip: Cars can only drive in here. Needs a way out somewhere else.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Marker.Exit.Tip: Cars can only drive out here. Needs a way in somewhere else.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Marker.Alley.Tip: Cars come in and go out through a real junction: the kerb opens and the street gets a crossing. Uses a few building plots on the street.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Marker.AlleyIn.Tip: A junction where cars can only drive in. Needs a way out somewhere else.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Marker.AlleyOut.Ti: A junction where cars can only drive out. Needs a way in somewhere else.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Marker.Footpath.Ti: A path for people only, from the lot to the sidewalk. Does not count as a car entrance.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Marker.BusStop.Tip: A bus stop on the street in front of the lot.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Marker.ZoningPatch: Keeps a strip by the street free for buildings at this spot. Width and depth are set under Buildings.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.EdgeZoning: Leaves a strip next to the street for buildings to grow on. The lot shrinks to make room.
FlowerPainter.Parking.EdgeZoning.None.Ti: The parking lot uses the whole area.
FlowerPainter.Parking.EdgeZoning.OneSide: Buildings along the side with the longest street frontage.
FlowerPainter.Parking.EdgeZoning.All.Tip: Buildings along every side that faces a street.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.ZoneType.T: What may be built there: homes, shops, offices… Automatic uses the city's usual zone.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.ZoningDept: How many plots deep the buildings reach, counted from the street (one plot is 8 m, the game allows up to 6).
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.ZoningPatc: How many plots wide each building plot marker is (one plot is 8 m).
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.AsphaltSur: The surface laid under the lanes and spaces.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.Greenery.T: Where grass, trees and bushes go instead of pavement.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Greenery.None.Tip: Paved from edge to edge. No trees.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Greenery.Edges.Tip: Planting along the outline and at the ends of rows. Rows sit back to back.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Greenery.Medians.T: Also a planted strip between back-to-back rows. Costs some spaces.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.AisleWidth: Wider lanes give cars more room to turn in.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.Setback.Ti: A planted strip between the outline and the first spaces. Tidier, costs spaces.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.RowAngleMo: Which way the rows of spaces run.
Rows run parallel to the longest straight side of the outline.
FlowerPainter.Parking.RowAngleMode.Acros: Rows run at right angles to the longest side.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.RowAngle.T: Sets the row angle for the whole lot.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.Grading.Ti: On sloped ground every row of spaces is levelled into a terrace (at most 2 % fall), with gentle ramps (at most 8 %) between the terraces. Off: the lot follows the ground as it is.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.SteepGrade: The ground is steep here: levelling the lot moves up to {0} m of earth at its edges.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.PerimeterR: A driving lane along the whole outline with a row of spaces on the outside. Off uses the full area for rows.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.CrossEvery: Spaces between short lanes that join neighbouring rows. 0 = none.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.EntranceSt: How an entrance joins the street outside.
FlowerPainter.Parking.EntranceStyle.Conn: An invisible lane that joins the street without changing it.
FlowerPainter.Parking.EntranceStyle.Alle: Builds a small alley into the street. The street gets a real junction and its kerb opens up; it costs a few zoning cells there.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.RowEndPlan: Ends each row with a patch of grass. Off packs in more cars.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.MedianDept: Width of the planted strip between back-to-back rows.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.GreenSurfa: The surface laid where there is no pavement.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.Trees.Tip: Tree types to plant. Empty = a mix of street trees.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.Bushes.Tip: Bush types to plant. Empty = a mix of bushes.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.PlantingDe: How much of the green is planted.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.Lanterns.T: Places street lights along the rows; lit at night.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.LanternAss: Which street light to use. Automatic picks single and double lights.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.LanternSpa: Largest gap between two lights along a row.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.EvShare.Ti: Share of spaces with a charger. Chargers stand in the planting behind a pair of spaces, close to the entrance.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.Accessible: Share of wide spaces for disabled drivers, placed closest to the entrance.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Control.Fee.Tip: What a car pays to park here.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Reason.NeedsEntran: Place at least one entrance for cars: a two-way entrance or driveway, or one way in and one way out. Footpaths are for people only.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Reason.EntryWithou: An entry without an exit - cars could not leave.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Reason.ExitWithout: An exit without an entry - place an entry.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.BadShape: This outline crosses itself. Move a corner so the edges don't cross.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.TooSmall: Too small for a parking lot ({0} m², needs at least {1} m²).
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.TooLarge: Too large for one parking lot ({0} m², at most {1} m²). Split it into smaller areas.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.NoEntrance: No entrance for cars yet. Pick an entrance type and click the outline next to a street.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.EntrancesSug: Entrances were placed on the nearest road. Move them along the outline if you like.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.EntranceNoPa: Entrance {0} has no straight path to a driving lane. Move the entrance.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.EntranceNoRo: Entrance {0} has no street outside it. Cars can only use it if a street is built there.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.EntrancesToo: Two entrances are on top of each other - one was left out.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.UnreachableS: {0} spaces could not be reached from an entrance and were left out.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.PerimeterRoa: Too narrow for a lane around the lot - built without it.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.SurfaceGaps: {0} m² of pavement or grass is missing: the game cannot display this shape there.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.LayoutFailed: The parking lot could not be planned: {0}
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.NoStalls: No parking space fits here. Try a wider area, narrower spaces or no lane around the lot.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.ReservedSpac: {0} spaces were left out because something else is already planned there.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.NoRoomForCha: No room for chargers: they need planting behind the spaces.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.NoRoomForAcc: No room for accessible spaces: they need a row of straight (90°) spaces.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.LotOwnerReje: The game cannot use this outline as one lot. Smooth out very sharp corners.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.TooManyEntra: At most {0} entrances per lot - {1} were left out.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.BusStopNoRoa: Bus stop {0} has no street in front of it. Move it next to a street.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.ZoningNoStre: No side of this lot faces a street, so no buildings can grow along it.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.ZoningPatchN: This building plot is not next to a street. Move it to a side that faces one.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.ZoningStreet: The street is too far away for buildings this deep. Increase the building depth or draw the lot closer to the street.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.ZoningLeaves: The building strips would leave no room for parking - built without them.
FlowerPainter.Parking.Issue.ZoningTrimme: {0} building strips were left out because parking runs through them.
